venue.subject: Halstead Royal British Legion Club

messages.subject: Halstead Royal British Legion Club
messages.body:
Hi. Natalie.
I'm karen.i help with the booking of the entertainment at the club.
You sent a message to Paul the secretary of the club.
Could you let me know how much Jake charges.
If he's self contained.
We are a small club ( holds about 40- 50 People at a push.
Our age range is 40s to 80s ( young).
Thankyou Karen

messages.subject: Halstead Royal British Legion Club
messages.body:
Hi Karen,

Thanks for getting back to me.

Jake is self-employed and runs a limited company. He’s fully self-contained with his own equipment and PA.

For a standard 2 × 1 hour set his fee is £250 if paid in cash. If paid by bank transfer there’s an additional £25 to cover fees, making it £275 total.

We can also work out a good deal if multiple dates are booked this year and into next year.

Would you like me to send over some more details about his show and check availability for you?

Best regards,
Natalie
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com

messages.subject: Halstead Royal British Legion Club
messages.body:
Hi Natalie.
Yes please. If you could send a link for music.
We are definitely interested. Won't be till next year as we are booked up for this year.We only have entertainment once a month.
We like a good range of music. And members like to get up and dance.
Thanks Karen.

messages.subject: Halstead Royal British Legion Club
messages.body:
Hi Natalie.
Hope not to hot for you.
Can I book Jake Essex for next year . Saturday 17 th July 2027
Please. @ 250.00 for 2 hours.
I would like to start at 8.30 pm and finish at 11pm.
I will contact you nearer the the time.
Thankyou Karen ( on behalf of Halstead Royal British Legion Club.
